description: Rewrite SystemUpdateService.IsUpdateEnabled to explicit control flow isomorphic with SystemInfoService, preserving the unconfigured default of true, and lock the disabled-start path with a runtime spec, a source-audit spec, and explicit-input parity assertions.

tasks.title: Rewrite IsUpdateEnabled gate to explicit control flow and lock it with specs
tasks.description: Rewrite SystemUpdateService.IsUpdateEnabled (SystemUpdateService.cs:605-609) from the single-line precedence-dependent expression `string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configured) || bool.TryParse(configured, out var enabled) && enabled` into an explicit control-flow form isomorphic to SystemInfoService.IsUpdateEnabled: presence-check `if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configured)) return bool.TryParse(configured, out var enabled) && enabled;` followed by a separate `return true;` (preserving the existing unconfigured default, since ValidateStart already enforces install mode and completeness independently). Keep ValidateStart's check ordering unchanged (install-mode -> enable-gate -> completeness -> dirty-source -> availability). Add test infrastructure and specs in SystemUpdateServiceSpecs.cs to cover the currently zero-coverage Enabled="false" start path, a source-audit guard against precedence-dependent single-line rewrites, and explicit-input ("true"/"false") parity with the display-path gate.
acceptanceCriteria: SystemUpdateService.IsUpdateEnabled is written as explicit control flow: an `if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configured))` presence check that returns `bool.TryParse(configured, out var enabled) && enabled`, followed by a separate `return true;` default — no single-line `|| ... && ...` precedence-dependent expression remains.

The unconfigured (null/empty/whitespace) default of `IsUpdateEnabled` still returns true; StartAsync under an unconfigured Enabled on a previously-startable local-source install reaches the same start/no-start decision and executes the same commands as before this change.
ValidateStart's check ordering is unchanged: install-mode check precedes the enable gate, which precedes install-completeness, dirty-source, and update-availability checks.

SystemUpdateServiceSpecs gains a factory variant (new narrow overload or override) that accepts an Enabled configuration value, defaulting to the existing "true" semantics so current specs are unaffected.

New spec StartAsync with Enabled="false" on an otherwise startable install (local-source, complete install, update available, clean source) returns (Started=false, Error="System update is disabled by configuration", Code="update_disabled", Status=null) and asserts no update lock is acquired, no job state is persisted, and no update command runs (reusing the existing mock-assertion pattern).

New spec verifies that when Enabled="false" coincides with a dirty source or no-update-available condition, the response is still Code="update_disabled" (the disable gate takes precedence over the later start-path checks).

New SourceAudit_IsUpdateEnabledUsesExplicitControlFlow spec reuses the existing ReadSource()/FindMethodEnd() helpers to assert the IsUpdateEnabled method body is NOT a single-line precedence-dependent expression (`string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(...) || bool.TryParse(...) && ...`) and DOES contain a presence-check `if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(` plus a separate default return.

Explicit-input parity is asserted in spec: for Enabled="true" both gates report enabled and the start path proceeds to other validations; for Enabled="false" the start path yields update_disabled and the display path (SystemInfoServiceSpecs baseline at :99) yields the disabled presentation. Unconfigured parity is intentionally excluded since the two gates' defaults deliberately differ.
SystemInfoService.IsUpdateEnabled implementation is not modified; no unified/shared gate function is introduced.
Server build passes with TreatWarningsAsErrors (npm test) and all SystemUpdateServiceSpecs / SystemInfoServiceSpecs pass.
tasks.output: Modified packages/server/src/MohistServer/SystemInfo/SystemUpdateService.cs (IsUpdateEnabled rewrite) and packages/server/tests/Mohist.Server.Tests/Specs/SystemSpecs/SystemUpdateServiceSpecs.cs (factory variant + Enabled="false" start-path spec + ordering spec + SourceAudit spec + parity assertions); npm test green.
tasks.notes: Pure structural rewrite preserving observable behavior; no API/contract/storage/Runner/Web/CLI changes. Do not touch SystemInfoService.IsUpdateEnabled (already correct). Do not unify the two gates into a shared function — their unconfigured defaults are intentionally different (SystemInfoService gates on local-source+ServerUnit; SystemUpdateService defaults true because ValidateStart independently enforces install mode and completeness). The new factory variant must default to "true" semantics to keep existing specs as regression baselines. Reference the D1 code block in design.md for the exact target form.
